annotations.title: Contract ABI, verified contract: ABI and source

description: The verified ABI of a smart contract on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon from Sourcify's open verification repository: contract name, compiler, match quality, every function and event signature, the full ABI, and for proxies the implementation contract with its ABI. Optional source=true adds the main source file (up to 20,000 characters). Unverified contracts are an uncharged 404. Use before calling or decoding a contract. Example: address=0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

chain.description: ethereum (default), base, arbitrum, optimism or polygon

source.description: true to include the main source file
